newsitem.title: USA: Degussa to buy DuPont peroxide business.
newsitem.headline: Degussa to buy DuPont peroxide business.

text.p: Degussa Corp and DuPont Co said Thursday Degussa will buy DuPont's worldwide hydrogen peroxide business while DuPont will buy Degussa's 1,3 propanediol technology for polyster manufacturing.
The companies did not disclose the terms of the deal, which they expect to close in the fourth quarter subject to the execution of definitive agreements and government approvals.

Degussa, a wholly-owned subsidiary of German chemical company Degussa AG, said in a statement DuPont's hydrogen peroxide business includes plants in Memphis, Tenn., and Maitland and Gibbons in Canada.
It added the deal also includes DuPont's interests in joint ventures in New Zealand and Indonesia.
The company said the acquisition will make it the leading hydrogen peroxide producer in the U.S. and solidify its worldwide No. 2 position.
